title: Highly recommend
text: Leader was accommodating to my pace, knowledgeable and fun. It’s a good way to tour the city and get in a run. Oriol often has 1,  2 or 3 in a group. I was the only one.
author: Carol_P

title: He ran my pace. I was glad to run a little faster than I’m used to because of stops.
text: Highly recommend!   Very accommodating, kind, and interesting.
author: D6463PQcarolp

title: What a great way to...
text: What a great way to explore the city.  Oriol was a wonderful guide - friendly and generous with his knowledge and time.  We saw some of the main sights but also some hidden gems.   Highly recommended!
author: Jeff_A

title: Best way to explore!
text: I needed to get a run in and needed to explore the city, this was a 10/10 experience. I don’t think you can have a better introduction to a new area than through the eyes of a local - and it helps if they’re good company for a run! Will be recommending to anyone that visits!
author: Caiti_K

title: Best Running Tour of Barcelona!
text: 10/10- second time running through Barcelona with Oriol and again it was fantastic!  Asked what I would like to see this time so I gave him a few suggestions and the loop was beautiful and informative. He has another run picked out for next year! If you are a runner, do not miss this experience!
author: laura_r

title: Great Experience! Great Run!
text: Tour guide, Oriol, was AMAZING! He catered the tour to exactly what we were interested in. My husband and I are intermediate runners and he kept our speed and showed us around multiple main points of Barcelona. Would definitely do it again! Thanks Oriol!
author: Allyn_M

title: Surina running with Oriol April 2026
text:
Thanks a lot to Oriol for the running experience on my first day in Barcelona. 
This was one of the highlights of my visit to Barcelona, starting off my visit with running in the city, guided by a great local guy, with lots of information.
author: Surina_N

title: Great experience - saw and learn so much!
text: This was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona, it was the perfect start to the day and allowed us to see so much in a short trip. Oriol was friendly and knowledgeable about the local area, he made the experience fun and I would definitely recommend this tour to anybody who enjoys staying active whilst learning lots about the local area from a local.
author: Ruggie2895

title: Best early morning run!
text: What an amazing early morning run through this beautiful city. Oriol was a great guide, very informative and super nice guy. Would highly recommend.
author: Arnold_T

title: Best way to see Barcelona's highlights
text:
Best way to see Barcelona's highlights. This tour is good if you have a tight schedule in Barcelona and don't want to miss the most important sights. Or if you have more time,this will serve as a primer so you can later decide what's worth more of your attention.
Oriol does a great job designing and customizing the tour to your liking and he has a wealth of knowledge to share about his city (Barcelona). He even finishes the tour by offering to take you to the terrace of the building where he lives which has breathtaking views of the city.  It is a great tour to take, don't miss it!
author: Enrique_V
